thread:
mika (People Ops): Idea: 'Kudos Courier' bike-drop popups next month — quick surprise deliveries to desks in SF and TOR during sprint week. Aim: 200 micro-deliveries (card + $3 spot token) across 2 days. Need route plan, courier vendor, downtown permits (if required), and budget sign-off. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

jules (Events): Love it. Proposed windows: SF Wed 11:30-1:30, TOR Thu 11:30-1:30. We do short routes (10 stops/hr) — need 4 couriers each city.

omar (Logistics): Vendor rec: PedalPulse does corporate drops, $28/hr per courier + $0.75 per stop if under 150 stops. They'll handle permits in TOR but SF needs city packet.

mika (People Ops): Budget ballpark? Our micro token is $3 physical coin; packaging & cards maybe $0.60 each.

tara (Finance): Quick calc: tokens $3 x200 = $600; packaging/cards ~$120; courier base (8 couriers x 3hrs x $28) =~ $672; misc/permitting $150 => rough total $1,542. Approve up to $1.6k from culture fund if receipts uploaded and vendor W-9 present. Code to GL 4-215.

ran (Facilities): SF permit note: for sidewalk activations under 2 hours we need a short event notice to building managers. I'll ping lobbies and secure 4 table drop spots near main entrances. TOR vendor will file permits.

zoe (Remote Ops): Remote folks? We should do an e-drop same day: 60 remote e-tokens ($3 each) mailed via batch email/egift. I can run batch if I get CSV by Mon noon.

jules (Events): Packing plan: we'll pre-assemble 220 packets (to include buffer): packet = 1 x $3 token, 1 x 2-line handwritten note, 1 x thin postcard with QR to nominate. Packing volunteers: SF Tue 3-5pm, TOR Wed 4-6pm. Can we get 6 volunteers per city?

omar (Logistics): I can source 220 small kraft envelopes + labels. Please add a column in the sheet for desk location (row/desk) so couriers can ring bell.

mika (People Ops): Will ask managers to populate desk locations by EOD Fri. Volunteers so far: jules, mika, rafael (Events), emily (People Ops). Need more for both cities. @here

tara (Finance): Please upload vendor quote to the sheet early next week. Also add internal packing slip note: "Charge to GL 4-215; retain receipts." We'll need final total before we PO.

jules (Events): Suggested packing checklist (final):
```
- 220 x kraft envelopes (pre-labeled)
- 220 x $3 tokens (sorted in coin trays)
- 220 x handwritten notes (2-line)
- 220 x nomination postcards (with QR)
- 2 x label printers
- 4 x route sheets per courier
- 1 x spare toolkit (tape, stapler, scissors)
```

ran (Facilities): Also request: staging tables at each lobby by 10:30 on event day. I'll coordinate with building teams and confirm by Mon.

zoe (Remote Ops): Remote CSV columns required: name,email,timezone,team. I'll send the batch in two waves (11:45 & 1:45 local time) to avoid late-night pings.

kudos-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Upload vendor W-9 + quote by Mon 12:00". :bell:

mika (People Ops): Thanks team — last bits: can someone run a quick privacy check on handwritten notes (no PHI), and jules please draft a short manager note asking folks to be at desks between 11:30-1:30. I'll update the sheet with counts and post volunteer sign-ups tomorrow. Pumped to do a playful nudge to recognition :bike::sparkles:
